mathematical_results.statement: For independent coordinate densities bounded by K, arbitrary real symmetric A and affine b,c, s_9(A)>=s>0 implies an essentially bounded density with norm <2422 K^2/s. Global continuity is not claimed; the no-pivot Fourier branch is continuous.

The s8 three-bank determinant ratio / Schur-translated pure-triangle curvature alone cannot imply a universal density bound. The explicit cap-one product-uniform family B=epsilon I2, C=E=sqrt(epsilon) I2 has determinant ratio 1 and P_HH=I2 but density norm at least 1/(6 sqrt(epsilon)). It does not satisfy the full s8 terminal spectral saturation and is not a QFORM counterexample.

Applying account04/B13 no-attainment purification to the slab kernel gives exact equality of the cap-one product-density and bounded-finite-union unit-product-set suprema, each <2422 |J| when s_9(A)>=1.

unresolved_implication: Construct a product-preserving overlap-one receiver using the absolute invertible-seed third-order packet while retaining the common physical anchor; ratio-only s8 curvature is insufficient.
